tradeoff: The client that ships with jellyscale is renamed from Fluster to Octave (owner: a scale spans an octave, so the client takes its name from the server's). Given up: nothing a viewer had.
entry: Fluster is renamed Octave. Any list of clients names Octave first, as jellyscale's own client (owner, 2026-11-20: 'we ought to say that Fluster is the first class citizen'); first-class names its place, not jellyscale work for it, which D-027 rules out. The docs say 'Octave (formerly Fluster)' at first mention until the client's repository is renamed; the docs checks that matched 'Fluster' in docs/status.md and docs/access.md match 'Octave', with the same meaning. Decisions, done tasks, backlog items and issue labels keep the name they were written with.
serves: PRODUCT.md: jellyscale ships with Octave, a desktop client that plays the original file whenever it can.
